## Objective

One machine-checked backlog from which board, dashboard, dependencies, traceability and ticket pages are generated.

## Scope

As stated in the objective and acceptance criteria; nothing beyond them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Validation rejects duplicate IDs, unknown dependencies, cycles, READY with unmet dependencies and DONE without evidence
- [ ] rendering is deterministic
- [ ] `render --check` detects stale files

## Test requirements

Unit tests for cycle detection, readiness and rendering.

## Deliverables

Code or configuration, tests, and updated documentation for this ticket.

## Definition of done

Implementation exists; relevant automated tests pass; acceptance criteria are met; security requirements are met; documentation is updated; review is complete (PD-004); evidence is linked; no critical defect is open; integration checks pass. Deployment tickets distinguish code complete, tested, deployment ready, deployed and production verified.
